---
title: "Cellerator"
---

Cellerator is a general computational framework for biological modeling,
especially cellular dynamics. It provides its own modeling interfaces,
structured state and interaction machinery, numerical operations, and
specialized native computation. Biology can guide the algorithms, layouts, and
kernels. PyTorch is optional for neural modules, autograd, and ecosystem
composition; the framework is not limited to Torch or dense tensors.

Cellerator enables scientific models without choosing each consumer's
biological assumptions. AnnData, Scanpy, and RAPIDS-singlecell remain valuable
upstream tools for established data preparation and analysis.

The library is early and not near complete. The dated
[implementation record](current_implementation.qmd) explains current
capabilities and evidence; the [architecture](architecture.qmd) describes
ownership boundaries and target organization.
